FROM vulnerability_aliases 
WHERE vulnerability_aliases.vulnerability_id = %(vulnerability_id_2)s::VARCHAR ORDER BY vulnerability_aliases.alias 
 LIMIT %(param_4)s::INTEGER) AS anon_3 UNION ALL SELECT anon_4.alias AS alias, anon_4.vulnerability_id AS vulnerability_id, anon_4._slot AS _slot, anon_4._position AS _position
